In this discussion with political analysts, we discuss the trends and results of the Seemanchal region of Bihar. Like 2020, Asaduddin Owaisi's AIMIM has emerged to win 3 seats and is leading on 3 seats as of now.
We discuss the reason behind Muslims voting in large numbers in Seemanchal and we also discuss what it means for the state.
Khabargaon is a modern-day digital platform that helps you travel through current affairs, explainers, ground reports, interviews and unique video shows. Stay tuned for more and more!
